name: Stelline
author: aashbury
description: A screensaver manager for Omarchy. Pick from a grid of savers — Omarchy's own, a themed wordmark, a clock, or your own from pictures, a clip, text or a description — with widgets for the time, missed notifications and your coding agents, and rules for night, battery or docking, including never locking while docked at your desk. Holds off for videos and games.

barWidget.description: Screensaver picker, timings, and stay awake. Left-click opens the panel, right-click toggles stay awake, middle-click previews.

schema.label: Screensaver
schema.description: A built-in id (terminal, wordmark, clock, blank) or one of your own savers

schema.label: Shuffle
schema.description: Pick a different saver each time from the checked ones.

schema.label: Next saver every (seconds)
schema.description: While the screensaver is up, move on to another checked saver this often (at least 30); 0 only changes it each time it starts.

schema.label: Lock at the lock timeout
schema.description: Off keeps the screensaver but never locks on idle.

schema.label: Not while a window is fullscreen
schema.description: Holds the screensaver and the lock off while the active window is fullscreen, for games that never ask.
